about: Decisions for the Comic room of the official Arts. comic.py reads this and nothing else. Items and drops are keyed by the first 10 characters of the picture sha1.

rules.scope: Official comic art without lettering: the 116 different pictures of the comic folders of _all, plus panels cut from the lettered pages. Fan comics (the instagram_p_* folders) are not here: they carry dialogue and the Comic room has them.
rules.comic: A picture of the Layla and Fanny webtoon is 1000 px wide at most, one of Guinevere and Vexana is wider than 1000 px. Checked against the page files by comic.py match.
rules.page: page_from says how the page was found: match (the picture was found inside that page of the lettered book files), match, weak (found, but with lettering over it and a transparent shape the score is low, checked by eye), or name (taken from the file name). A file name can be wrong: layla/28-1.png is on page 38 and layla/13-3.png is on page 14.
rules.panel: panel_from says how the panel number was found: name (the file name gives the panel and the page agrees) or order on the page (used only where the pictures shown cover the whole page, so the order from the top is the number). Panels count from the top of the page. Empty when it is not known. A cut from a page counts the panels that were not cut.
rules.cuts: mode component cuts one panel (a slanted one too) out of a white page by its gutters and leaves the paper corners transparent. mode page takes the whole page. Every cut was looked at for lettering. Candidates looked at: 100 art bands and 21 uncovered panels on the 42 Aspirant pages, and 29 Guinevere and Vexana pages that had parts not in the list. Kept: 5. Almost every other free panel carries a sound effect in lettering (BANG, SCRATCH, BAROOM) or a bubble.
rules.sizes: t is 480 px wide, p is at most 1280 px wide, f is the full size (long side at most 3840, or 5000 when the picture is taller than 3840). Never upscaled.
rules.floor: A picture under 250,000 pixels (width times height) is left out: it cannot be read when it is shown large. Nothing is upscaled.
rules.y: y is the row of the top of the picture in its page file (found by comic.py match). The room is in reading order by comic, page, y.
